description: Automation engine state machine taxonomy, failure modes, error classification, and self-healing action transitions.

states.description: Engine standing by, awaiting workflow or routine invocation.
Transitioning between Backbone.js hash routes and verifying page mount.
In combat awaiting turn processing, skill lockout, or server damage resolution.
In combat with HUD active and action buttons clickable.
Page reload triggered, awaiting DOMContentLoaded, Zepto, and CreateJS re-initialization.
Battle concluded, inspecting rewards, honors, tokens, and Blue/Gold chests.
Pending battle unjamming in progress at #quest/assist/unclaimed.
Handling unexpected dialogs, confirmation prompts, or AP/EP recovery modals.
Session expired or redirect to #top, executing Mobage OAuth handshake.
Active verification challenge detected, inputs halted, awaiting human intervention.
Unrecoverable failure or safety ceiling breached, shutting down cleanly.

errorTaxonomy.description: DOM frame or execution context detached during navigation or iframe transitions.
Browser navigation or F5 reload destroyed the active JavaScript evaluation context.
CDP WebSocket disconnected or remote browser unresponsive.
Unregistered modal dialog blocking user interaction with the combat HUD or menu.
Raid was defeated by other players or player was evicted due to 0 HP party wipe.
DOM mounted with blank canvas or CreateJS ticker failed to advance after reload.
Anti-cheat verification container, image puzzle, or Cloudflare challenge detected.
